title: CvDownloads
description: data/cv/downloads.yaml: the approved PDFs offered for download, each in data/cv/downloads/ and served at /cv/<file> (specs/004-interactive-cv/data-model.md, Download). Written by scripts/import-cv.ts. At most one of each kind is checked by validate.ts.

downloads.x-error: must list at most two downloads

kind.description: plain (the job-site version) or visual (the designed page).
kind.x-error: is not a download kind (expected plain or visual)

file.description: The file name in data/cv/downloads/. Fixed per kind (owner decision 6), so a new version replaces the old at the same link (FR-020).
file.x-error: is not a CV file name (expected alexander-webber-cv.pdf or alexander-webber-cv-visual.pdf)

title.description: The link text. Hashed with the file's bytes.

approved.description: The owner's approval: its date is shown as "Last updated"; sha256 covers kind, file, title and the sha256 of the file's bytes.

file.x-error: must be alexander-webber-cv.pdf for the plain CV
must be alexander-webber-cv-visual.pdf for the visual CV
